abilities.critical_failure: The creature takes 8d8+12 persistent bleed damage and is blinded for as long as the persistent damage lasts.
abilities.effect: Blood seeps from the eyes of all creatures within 30 feet, dealing persistent bleed damage. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 33 Fortitude save.
abilities.failure: The creature takes 4d8+6 persistent bleed damage and is dazzled for as long as the persistent damage lasts.
abilities.name: Weep Blood
abilities.success: The creature takes 2d8+3 persistent bleed damage and is dazzled for 1 round.

traits.name: Divine
traits.text:
This magic comes from the divine tradition, drawing power from deities or similar sources. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to divine magic.

traits.name: Necromancy
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the necromancy school of magic, typically involving forces of life and death.

hazard.description: A wailing spirit appears and gouges their own eyes. As they do, blood seeps from the eyes of those who witness the act, obscuring their vision.
hazard.disable: DC 30 Diplomacy (master) to talk the spirit out of gouging its eyes or DC 32 Religion (trained) to ease the spirit's sorrows
hazard.name: Blood Tears
hazard.stealth: DC 32 (master) to notice your vision tint red

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
